Networking in Amsterdam this week

16 – 22 Nov · 1 event

Meet-ups, mixers and social evenings where the point is meeting new people, whether for work, because you are new in town or through a shared interest. Good for newcomers to Amsterdam, freelancers and anyone growing their circle, in a relaxed setting rather than a full programme. The list is refreshed every week. Every listing is checked on the organiser's own page. Times and prices can change, so check the organiser's link before you go.

  1. Expats Connect: Career Switch + Networking

    Networking · Business · Drink

    When
    Wed 18 Nov, 18:30–20:30
    Where
    Marina I-Dock, IJdok 4, Amsterdam (Centrum)
    Price
    Free (optional €2 supporter ticket)
    Organiser
    AIC - Amsterdam International Commnunity - Expats

    An after-work drinks for internationals feeling stuck in their careers — CV and LinkedIn tips from a recruiter-turned-coach, live CV feedback and plenty of time to swap leads.
